trap.label: do it × do so
trap.wrong: She tried to settle and did it quickly.
trap.right: She tried to settle and did so quickly.
trap.why: Em português “fez isso” retoma a ação com um pronome. Em inglês formal, retome um verbo com do so, não do it.

mcq.q: “The first offer was better than the second ___.”

opts: I will sign if you will sign it.
I will vote if you will.

fix.wrong: The first lawyer was better than the second lawyer one.
fix.right: The first lawyer was better than the second one.

fix.wrong: They endorsed the plan and they did it publicly.
fix.right: They endorsed the plan and did so publicly.

fix.wrong: I will sign if you will it.
fix.right: I will vote if you will.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com one: “I prefer this plan to that plan.”
rewrite.answer: I prefer this plan to that one.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com do so: “She signed, and she signed quickly.”
rewrite.answer: She signed and did so quickly.

rewrite.prompt: Aplique elipse: “I will sign if you will sign.”
rewrite.answer: I will vote if you will.
